_about: Manual review of every sample that was not a clean hit. 'real' = the model got it wrong; 'ambiguous' = the question or relation is vague, benchmark verdict kept; 'disputed' = the benchmark label looks wrong on inspection. Official scores never change; disputed items are reported separately.
